discription: A basic saw wave synthesizer with an ADSR envelope. It produces a rich, bright tone suitable for leads or pads.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, attack=0.01, decay=0.1, sustain=0.8, release=1.0; var sig; var env = EnvGen.ar( Env.adsr(attack, decay, sustain, release, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2 ); sig = Saw.ar(freq) * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
